name: Motion for a resolution
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the protection of EU companies, jobs and products against unfair competition from non-EU countries
part_text:
The European Parliament is asking the European Commission to do more to protect EU companies and jobs from unfair competition from outside the EU. It wants better enforcement of product safety and origin rules, especially for cheap goods sold online, faster use of trade defence measures against subsidised imports, and reform of customs so low-value parcels are no longer exempt from duties. It also calls for stronger consumer protection and support for affected businesses. This is a set of requests and opinions, not a change in law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission to act on customs, trade defence and online sales rules.
- **Who it affects:** EU manufacturers, small businesses, farmers, workers, online shoppers and customs authorities.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Commission, Council and national governments; they decide whether to act.
